_comment: The wrapper form of config/endpoints.json: a { "endpoints": [...], "inspector": {...} }
object instead of a bare array. A bare array still works and is the normal case;
this form only ADDS the optional gateway-wide "inspector" block.
The inspector opens a local Swing window listing the last N LLM calls; click one
to see its assembled URL, headers, and full request/response bodies. It exists for
D and T, A at the most — NEVER production: enabling it turns a headless backend
into one with a GUI, and it surfaces detail (potentially including credentials)
that only the key holder / bill payer should authorise. Absent block, or
"enabled": false, means the gateway runs headless exactly as before.
enabled        launch the window and start capturing (default false)
maxCalls       ring size — only the most recent this-many calls are retained
revealSecrets  show real credential values instead of <redacted> (default false;
the owner asserting this screen is theirs alone)
